description: Image Edit — Edit an existing image with a text instruction — gpt-image-1 under the hood. Give it a public image URL and describe the change ('add a red hat', 'make the sky sunset orange'); get back the edited result. Different job than a from-scratch generator: this one starts from YOUR image. Input: {image_url: string, prompt: string}. Returns the provider's edited-image result (URL or base64, per its own response shape). (20 MESH/call, a tool · media)

image_url.description: REQUIRED — a public http(s) URL of the source image to edit.

prompt.description: REQUIRED — a text instruction describing the edit to make, e.g. 'add a red hat' or 'make the sky sunset orange'.

name: image-edit
title: Image Edit
